recipes.description: The pie Jim is known for: flaky crust, tart apples, and a crumb topping worth fighting over. This entry shows the format each family recipe will follow.

handwritingNotes.note: The card reads 'a pinch or two of nutmeg' and the amount is hard to make out. We went with a pinch. If you remember it differently, let us know.

ingredients: 6 tart apples, peeled and thinly sliced
2 tablespoons cold butter, cut into small pieces
1/2 cup flour, for the crumb topping
1/4 cup cold butter, for the crumb topping
recipes.sourceNote: Example entry transcribed from a handwritten recipe card, October 2026. Wording preserved as written.
steps: Line a 9-inch pie plate with one crust, letting the edges hang over.
Toss the apples with the sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon juice.
Pile the apples into the crust and dot with the cold butter pieces.
Mix the remaining 1/2 cup flour and brown sugar, cut in the 1/4 cup butter until crumbly, and scatter over the apples.
Fold the overhanging crust up over the edge and crimp.
Bake 20 minutes, then lower the heat to 375°F and bake about 35 minutes more, until the topping is golden and the filling bubbles.
Cool at least 2 hours before slicing so the filling sets.
recipes.title: Jim's Apple Pie

recipes.description: Crispy cutlets, bright marinara, and a blanket of melted mozzarella. Joe's weeknight show-off. This entry shows the format each family recipe will follow.
recipes.sourceNote: Example entry transcribed from a handwritten recipe card, October 2026. Wording preserved as written.
steps: Season the cutlets with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, dip in egg, and coat with breadcrumbs.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the cutlets about 3 minutes per side, until deep golden. Work in batches if needed.
Spoon marinara over each cutlet, top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and browns in spots.
Rest 5 minutes, scatter with basil, and serve.
recipes.title: Joe's Chicken Parmesan
